record.paper_title: Three open problems in function theoretic operator theory
record.original_question: Let Theta be a finite Blaschke product, let K_Theta be its associated model space in the Hardy space H^2(D), and let S_Theta be the compression P_Theta M_z restricted to K_Theta of multiplication by z. Let B be another finite Blaschke product with degree(B) < degree(Theta). Must max{|B(z)| : z is in W(S_Theta)} be at least 1/2, where W(S_Theta) is the numerical range of S_Theta?

evidence.quote: Let Theta denote a degree-n finite Blaschke product
This version of Crouzeix's conjecture is sometimes referred to as the Level Set Crouzeix Conjecture.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ and let $H^2(\mathbb{D})$ denote the Hardy space on $\mathbb{D}$. For a finite Blaschke product $\Theta$ of degree $n$, define the associated model space
$$K_\Theta = H^2(\mathbb{D})\ominus \Theta H^2(\mathbb{D}),$$
an $n$-dimensional subspace of $H^2(\mathbb{D})$. Let $P_\Theta$ be the orthogonal projection of $H^2(\mathbb{D})$ onto $K_\Theta$, and let $M_z$ be multiplication by the independent variable on $H^2(\mathbb{D})$. Define the compressed shift
$$S_\Theta = P_\Theta M_z\big|_{K_\Theta},$$
a bounded linear operator on $K_\Theta$ with numerical range
$$W(S_\Theta) = \{\langle S_\Theta f, f\rangle : f\in K_\Theta,\ \|f\|=1\}.$$

Question: For every finite Blaschke product $\Theta$ and every finite Blaschke product $B$ with $\deg(B) < \deg(\Theta)$, must
$$\max\{|B(z)| : z\in \overline{W(S_\Theta)}\} \ \geq\ \tfrac{1}{2}\,?$$
artifact.status_search_result: The level set Crouzeix conjecture for compressed shifts on model spaces of finite Blaschke products has been verified in several special cases (e.g., unicritical Blaschke products of degree 4, certain 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 matrix classes) in work by Bickel, Garcia, Gorkin, Liaw and collaborators (Journal d'Analyse Mathématique, 2023; Concrete Operators, 2024), but the general statement remains open.

status_evidence.title: Blaschke Products, Level Sets, and Crouzeix's Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes the level set Crouzeix conjecture in several cases but not in general.
status_evidence.claim: The LSC conjecture is proved in special cases, indicating it remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Crouzeix's conjecture, compressions of shifts, and classes of nilpotent matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes the LSC conjecture for several classes of 3x3, 4x4 and 5x5 compressions of the shift.
status_evidence.claim: Continued partial progress suggests the full conjecture is still open.
